verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API allows pulling data out (e.g., 'Pull data from Klaviyo to create dashboards, sync to other systems') and lacks a rigid schema, implying some data portability, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature, no explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export tool, and no data-portability/account-closure policy. missing for 10: dedicated data export tool, explicit open-format guarantee, documented full-account export/deletion process, independent confirmation of export completeness.
